summary: Blockout is a previs editor built with three.js. It opens straight into the 'Low Tide' project. I saved 5 views, and all 5 replayed and matched when saved: (1) stage: the Stage workspace, with the scene/shot list and Library (sequences, choreographer, stage presets, asset grid) on the left, the 3D viewport with marks and paths in the centre, and the scene, lighting and shot settings panel on the right; (2) shoot-camera: Shoot mode, with the framing and recording toolbar, a timeline of marks for the camera and characters, and the Camera panel (sensor, lens, position and aim, track subject); (3) deliver: Deliver mode, with the framed view and the export panel (target generator, passes, resolution, labels, export buttons, generated prompt); (4) help-dialog: the in-app Help dialog's Quick start tab, laid out as a grid of cards; (5) entity-inspector: the character DEX selected in the viewport, showing the move handles and DEX's settings (position, sliders, pose, marriage, label colour). View 5 is reached by clicking at screen coordinates (1027, 420), because nothing else can pick the figure out in the 3D view. Not saved: 'Populate from reference…' showed no dialog when clicked; the Animate tab only shows instructions until a character is selected; other scenes use the same layouts. I never found a screen for switching projects or seeing the project list, so the other four projects aren't captured.
